hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"/*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; bunx prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; case "$f" in *.ts|*.js|*.svelte) bunx eslint "$f" >&2 || exit 2 ;; esac; }
